name: Promenade Temecula
summary: Chain known for unique gadgets, gifts & lifestyle items, such as electronics & travel accessories.
description: Promenade Temecula is your go-to shopping mall in Temecula, California, offering an exciting lineup of the best brands in the market as well as a variety of dining options. Whether you're looking for retail therapy, engaging events to enjoy with family or friends, or a delicious meal, this Temecula mall has it all with extended holiday hours and entertainment options including a Regal Edwards cinema.
demographics: Promenade Temecula serves the rapidly growing Inland Empire market of Southern California, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals from Temecula and surrounding communities. The trade area is characterized by newer residential developments with households that have above-average incomes and a strong preference for convenient, one-stop shopping destinations. Typical visitors include families with children seeking entertainment and dining experiences alongside their shopping trips, as well as younger demographics drawn to the movie theater and contemporary retail offerings.
